scholarships.title: Excellence Master Fellowships (Faculty of Science, University of Geneva)

existing.description: The Faculty of Science of the University of Geneva runs an Excellence Fellowship programme, supported by external partners, for students who want to pursue a Master of Science in one of the disciplines covered by the Faculty. The fellowship is a grant of CHF 10,000 to CHF 15,000 per year with no teaching duties, awarded for one year and extended for the regular duration of the chosen Master's programme if the holder is academically successful at the end of the first semester. Selection is based on excellence, and applications are made online from the beginning of January with a 28 February deadline.
eligibility: Very good performance in a bachelor's degree, ranking among the best students of year 2 of the home university
Must meet the admission criteria of the chosen Master programme at the UNIGE Faculty of Science
Must not already have started a Master programme at the UNIGE Faculty of Science
Must have completed the UNIGE enrolment/registration procedure for the chosen master's programme before the fellowship application is considered
Open regardless of home university or country of residence
existing.eligibility_summary: Open to students from any university worldwide with very good performance in their bachelor's studies who rank among the best of their year 2, and who also meet the admission criteria of the Master programme they choose. Students who have already started a Master programme at the Faculty of Science cannot apply.
benefits: Grant of CHF 10,000 to CHF 15,000 per year
Extended for the full regular duration of the chosen Master's programme if academically successful
coverage: Grant of CHF 10,000 to CHF 15,000 per year
No teaching duties attached to the fellowship
Renewal for the regular duration of the Master's programme conditional on academic success
requirements: Application must be a SINGLE pdf file
Application can be in English or French
Complete the UNIGE enrolment procedure as described on the Admissions office website
All listed clauses must be completed or the file will not be considered
documents: Single PDF file containing all documents, in English or French
Scan of national identity card or passport
Transcript of exams passed during the bachelor's education, with all grades
Motivation letter describing specific scientific interests and motivation to pursue an MSc at the University of Geneva
Two letters of reference from professors attesting aptitude to the programme
Proof of enrolment: scan of the UNIGE card, or the mail entitled 'UNIGE-Candidature: Depot de votre dossier' confirming registration has begun
Optional: GRE results, TOEFL or other language test scores
existing.english_requirement: No separate English test is mandated for the fellowship. Master's programmes are either entirely in English or in English and French; TOEFL or other language test results may be included as pertinent information in the file.
application_method: Register for the chosen master's programme at UNIGE (enrolment procedure)
Wait for the e-mail with a personal link to the fellowship application form (sent from the beginning of January each year)
Upload one single PDF containing all required documents
existing.selection_notes: Candidate selection is based on excellence. Selection is made by the Grant Committee of the Faculty of Science. Incomplete files are not considered.
existing.best_fit: High-performing students from any country applying to an MSc at the UNIGE Faculty of Science in astronomy, biology, chemistry and biochemistry, computer science, mathematics, physics, pharmaceutical sciences or earth sciences.
existing.notes: The Fellowship amount is published as a range (CHF 10,000-15,000), not a single figure, so funding_amount is left null rather than guessing a value. Some fellowships in this scheme are financed by external partners, e.g. the Werner Foundation and private Geneva foundations.
existing.duration: One year, then extended for the regular duration of the chosen Master's programme (three or four semesters) if academically successful after the first semester
existing.application_period: The application is made online, from the beginning of January of each year; after registering you receive an e-mail with a personal link to the application form. Deadline 28 February.
existing.deadline_display: Next application deadline is 28 February, 2026 (for Masters starting September 14, 2026).
existing.program_type: Faculty-level excellence grant scheme for incoming Master of Science students
